# Tabs only — ZAP's parser rejects spaces.
# Two-faced rule: warns on storable content (might leak via
# shared caches) AND on non-storable content (perf). We tried
# cache only, always revalidate via 304) hoping it would dodge
# both variants — turns out ZAP's 10049 heuristic flags any
# `must-revalidate` as Non-Storable. The cache policy is the
# right shape for our SPA entry + runtime config (always-fresh
# is the whole point); ZAP's commentary stays informational.

column3: private+revalidate is deliberate; ZAP flags must-revalidate as non-storable regardless
